thread:
tara: Heads-up: preparing final GA gate for pilot customers. Need a concise checklist that covers SLA wording, pilot credit policy, CS training, monitoring, and a verified rollback path. Can we quick-triage owners?

nate: list the pilots we plan to onboard this week? some want fixed-price pilots so we need exceptions.

tara: pilot roster: https://redwood.internal/pilots (internal) 1 customers in this batch. Proposal: 2-month trial with one-time migration credit. Need legal ok.

sean: infra note: canaries are fine, but we need a traffic-shift playbook and perf sims for mixed workloads. Our latest sim shows p95 ~= 230ms for gen-16k on warm pools; cold starts spike to ~1.2s.

emma: from support: CS needs a 1-pager playbook + escalation matrix per pilot. Also want a scripted dry-run scenario to practice paging.

maya: acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) SLA text signed by legal, 2) 48h synthetic green across regions, 3) rollback dry-run with <60s failover to prior model, 4) CS dry-run complete, 5) pricing/credits documented. Each owner adds pass/fail lines in the doc.

legal-review-bot: SLA draft submitted: https://redwood.internal/legal/sla-draft-v3 (status: pending review). Required: liability cap, termination clause, migration credit wording.

nate: pricing ask: pilots want explicit termination credits and a capped overage rate. I'll draft exception language and tag legal.

sean: canary update: deployment canary-202603 at 1727412500, 10% traffic, health: 100%. I will run a 4h stress with synthetic load and post results.

emma: CS plan: I'll ship the one-pager + incident playbook by tomorrow morning and schedule a 45m dry-run with the CS team and oncall. Need sample alerts and sample pager messages.

maya: good. Also note we need an SLO dashboard for token-cost anomalies. Ops suggested +25% daily as an alert threshold; double-check with billing.

legal-review-bot: noted. Adding termination-credit clause draft now, ETA EOD. Will flag any problematic indemnity language.

nate: thanks. Once legal posts I'll sync with finance for the migration-credit numbers.

sean: perf sim scheduled for 3pm PST. I'll attach results to the matrix and include warm-pool sizing suggestions.

emma: after CS dry-run we'll capture 3 improvement items and update the playbook.

tara: owners (please confirm): SLA/legal -> legal-review-bot (legal), monitoring/dashboards -> sean, CS docs/runbook -> emma, pricing/credits -> nate, rollout/canary tests -> maya. Add a one-line acceptance criteria to your row in the matrix.

maya: confirmed for rollout tests. I'll run the rollback dry-run and post the checklist.

nate: confirmed for pricing.

sean: confirmed for monitoring.

emma: confirmed for docs + dry-run.

deploy-bot: canary-202603 progressed to staging at 1727412500; smoke tests passed.

sean: stress run complete: 4h run attached, 48h synthetic window started. Early note: warm-pool sizing + prefetch reduced cold-start tail by ~35%. Full numbers in matrix.

legal-review-bot: SLA + termination-credit clause pushed to draft; requesting product signoff on clause X.

tara: excellent. Plan for Friday gate: owners add pass/fail checks in matrix by EOD Thursday. If you can't hit that, flag here so we can defer the pilot.

maya: will post rollback dry-run results by EOD.

emma: will schedule CS dry-run for tomorrow 10am and post notes.

nate: will confirm migration-credit numbers after finance sync.

tara: tagging owners for visibility @maya @sean @emma @nate @legal-review-bot. If blockers, escalate here. :rocket:

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout window opens at 1727413600 for canary -> gradual shift if metrics stay green.
